description.zh:
出站流量源IP地址列表（至少添加2个，最多可添加6个）。

>为了保证高可用，出站终端节点要求至少添加2个出站源IP地址，而且建议这2个IP地址分配在不同的可用区，出站终端节点允许添加的出站源IP地址最多为6个
description.en:
The list of source IP addresses for outbound traffic. You must add at least two IP addresses. You can add up to six IP addresses.

> To ensure high availability (HA), add at least two source IP addresses for the outbound endpoint. We recommend that you allocate these IP addresses in different zones. You can add a maximum of six source IP addresses.
The ID of the zone where the vSwitch resides.

description.zh: 子网掩码，交换机的IPv4网段。
description.en: The IPv4 CIDR block of the vSwitch.

description.zh: 子网掩码参数范围内的IP地址（留空则系统自动分配）。
description.en: The IP address. The IP address must be within the specified CIDR block. If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically assigns an IP address.

description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：

- zh：中文。

- en：英文。

默认值：en
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese.

- en: English.

Default value: en

description.zh: 终端节点名称，最长20个字符，超过限制会报错。
description.en: The name of the endpoint. The name can be up to 20 characters long. An error is reported if the limit is exceeded.

description.zh:
安全组ID，安全组里面的规则将应用于出站VPC。

>为了避免误操作造成线上流量中断，创建出站终端节点之后，无法更改此值。
description.en:
The ID of the security group. The rules in the security group are applied to the outbound VPC.

> To prevent service interruptions, you cannot change this value after you create the outbound endpoint.

description.zh:
出站专有网络ID（VPC ID），解析器所有出站的DNS查询流量都将经由此VPC进行流量转发。

>为了避免误操作造成线上流量中断，创建出站终端节点之后，无法更改此值。
description.en:
The ID of the outbound virtual private cloud (VPC). All outbound DNS query traffic from the Resolver is forwarded through this VPC.

> To prevent service interruptions, you cannot change this value after you create the outbound endpoint.
The region ID of the outbound VPC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz add-resolver-endpoint --name endpoint-test-name --vpc-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-0jl96awrjt75ezglc0000 --security-group-id sg-0jld3m9yq7l2cw120000 --ip-config VSwitchId=vsw-0jlgeyq4oazkh5xue0000 Ip=172.16.XX.XX CidrBlock=172.16.XX.XX/24 AzId=cn-hangzhou-a --lang en --region cn-hangzhou
